If you’ve been thinking about getting a hair topper, one of the biggest concerns might be how it will look as your natural hair grows. After all, hair length and texture are constantly changing, so how can you maintain a flawless look with a topper over time? The good news is, with the right techniques and a little maintenance, your hair topper can look just as great as your hair grows. Let’s dive into how you can keep your look fresh and natural, no matter how long your natural hair gets!

Table of contents

  1. Why hair growth impacts topper look
  2. How to keep a natural look as hair grows
  3. Adjusting the topper for different lengths
  4. Which one’s right for you?
  5. Common concerns for hair toppers

 

Why hair growth impacts topper look

As your natural hair grows, it can change the way your hair topper blends with your hair. Longer hair may create more volume, while your natural texture might shift, making it trickier to maintain that perfect seamless look. But don’t worry! There are simple ways to adjust and keep everything looking natural.

Your quality hair topper should always complement your natural hair length and texture. When your hair grows out, the topper may appear slightly different in terms of how it blends. If your hair has grown significantly, the topper might look a little too short in comparison. That’s when it’s time to make some adjustments to ensure a smooth transition.

How to keep a natural look as hair grows

Maintaining a natural look as your hair grows is all about finding balance. Here are a few simple tips:

  1. Regular Trims: Just like your natural hair, your hair topper might need a little trim as it grows. If the topper starts to look too short in comparison to your growing hair, a quick trim can make sure everything blends smoothly.
  2. Layering: If your hair has grown longer, consider layering both your natural hair and your topper. Layering helps your hair transition from one length to another more easily, and it can prevent any awkward ‘bumpy’ spots where your natural hair and topper meet.
  3. Styling Options: Different hairstyles can help disguise any differences between your natural hair and the topper. Try waves or curls to soften the line where they meet, or go for a half-up style that combines both.

Adjusting the topper for different lengths

As your natural hair grows, your topper can be easily adjusted to keep the look natural. One of the most common ways to make your topper blend seamlessly is by trimming it. Many clip-on hair toppers are designed to be versatile, so trimming them to match your natural hair length is an option.

Alternatively, you can also adjust the placement of your topper. If you wear a clip-on hair topper, you can move it slightly higher or lower on your head to match the new growth of your hair. This small adjustment can help maintain a perfect blend with your hair, especially as it changes in texture and length.

Silk hair toppers vs. skin hair toppers: Which one’s right for you?

When choosing a hair topper, it’s important to understand the different types available. Two popular options are Silk Hair Toppers and Skin Hair Toppers. Both offer unique benefits, and your choice will depend on your specific needs and the look you’re aiming for.

Silk Hair Toppers:

Silk toppers are designed to mimic the look and feel of natural scalp skin. They are perfect for creating a realistic, natural appearance, especially when your natural hair grows. The silk material allows for breathability and comfort, which is perfect for those who wear their topper all day long. Silk hair toppers in mumbai also offer more flexibility when it comes to adjusting the fit and length, ensuring a seamless blend with your growing hair.

Skin Hair Toppers:

Skin toppers are made with a special ‘skin-like’ material that resembles the scalp. These are incredibly lightweight and offer a more breathable option for those who have sensitive scalps. Skin toppers are also an excellent choice for blending in with natural hair textures, especially if you have thinner or finer hair. As your natural hair grows, the flexibility of a skin topper allows it to be adjusted and trimmed to suit your evolving style.

Common concerns for hair toppers in mumbai

Will my hair topper need frequent adjustments?

No, but small tweaks can help keep your topper looking natural as your hair grows. Regular trims and careful styling are usually all that’s needed to maintain a seamless look.

Can I trim my hair topper myself?

Yes! Most hair toppers can be trimmed to fit your natural hair length. Just make sure to cut in small increments and blend carefully with your natural hair.

How do I style my topper and natural hair to blend well?

Styling your hair in soft waves or curls can help blend the transition between your natural hair and the topper. Half-up styles also work great for concealing any visible lines.

Wrapping Up

As your hair grows, you don’t have to worry about your hair topper looking short or out of place. With a few adjustments, a bit of trimming, and the right styling techniques, you can keep your hair looking fabulous and natural.
